title: V03 Clip 5
shots: Nobody cared, because the story was true. The internet really did change everything.
2000 trading floor celebrating, confetti, crane up past the crowd to the ticker
The story was right. The price was wrong.
breakfast table: newspaper THE INTERNET CHANGES EVERYTHING gets a tick; a red 100x PROFIT sticker slaps on
Then the first drop came. In about five weeks, Cisco fell roughly thirty percent.
over-the-shoulder: two traders watch the amber terminal; candles turn red; -30%
And people said exactly what you're hearing today. It's a dip. Buy it.
2000 living room TV news BUY THE DIP | 2026 phone feed posts It's a dip. Buy it.
Even better, it bounced. Three months after the peak, Cisco was down less than twenty percent.
terminal: candles bounce green, glass card -16% from peak, traders lean in
The dip buyers felt like geniuses. But that bounce was a trap.
floor celebrates, high fives, then lights flicker red
Traders call it a sucker's rally, a rise that pulls people back in right before the real damage starts.
mousetrap baited with a glowing green arrow, little investors walk in, SNAP
